try_name: Classic Smoked Meat Poutine tried by maya
comment: Incredibly generous smoked meat portion and the gravy had real depth. Best classic poutine I've had near the office.

try_name: Classic Smoked Meat Poutine tried by maverick
comment: Solid classic. Curds were squeaky fresh, though I'd have liked the gravy a touch hotter.

try_name: Truffle Duck Confit Poutine tried by raphael
comment: Duck confit was fall-apart tender and the truffle aroma actually came through instead of being a gimmick. Worth the price.

try_name: Truffle Duck Confit Poutine tried by maya
comment: Tasty but pretty rich - could barely finish half. Great for sharing, not for a solo lunch.

try_name: Spicy BBQ Pulled Pork Poutine tried by maverick
comment: Pulled pork was smoky and the BBQ sauce balanced the heat well. Fries got a little soggy under the sauce though.

try_name: Spicy BBQ Pulled Pork Poutine tried by maya
comment: Way spicier than advertised for me - couldn't really taste anything else after a few bites. Good if you love heat.

try_name: Montreal Smoked Meat Deluxe Poutine tried by maverick
comment: Deluxe toppings actually deliver here - pickles and mustard drizzle cut through the richness perfectly.

try_name: Smoked Meat Diner Poutine tried by maverick
comment: Curds were rubbery and the smoked meat tasted reheated. Disappointing compared to the other smoked meat option.

try_name: Smoked Meat Diner Poutine tried by maya
comment: Better than I expected after reading other reviews - fresh batch must have made the difference. Good value.

try_name: Heritage Poutine Originale tried by raphael
comment: This is the poutine that started it all for me. Classic done right - nothing fancy, just perfectly executed.
